Response(at_exit, holding_box) is (G(at_exit -> F holding_box)), allows later but no later. However "if you reach exit, you must be carrying the box" at exit. There is no template for same-step implication except Response since b can happen at that moment; but if at_exit only last step, F holding_box equals holding at last? holding_box could become true after? It says "If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box." This is conditional, no obligation to reach. So no Existence(at_exit). The first conditional also no existence of box_fell. So only two Response/ChainResponse.

Wait example: step 21 box_fell true, holding false. step 22 pickup: holding true. So next step yes. If a box falls due while agent picks up on due step, action applies first then events: box falls on that step? The example says picking it up again on due step counts as carrying (action applies first, then events), so it falls on that step. Then next move pick up. So chain okay.

Need ensure "very next move" maybe means next agent action, not next time step. Actions happen each step, so same.

Second: "If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box." At_exit condition. Template Response(at_exit, holding_box). But note Response(a,b) needs b at or after last step a. Here holding_box condition lasts. at_exit last step. It requires holding_box at or after at_exit. Since at_exit is last, holding_box at same step (can't after). Good. No Existence.
